reason: I've downloaded and quit like four tracking apps already, so I'm not paying for Pro before I know I'll still be logging in three weeks. If anything I'd grab the free summary before my next appointment and stop there.
objection: An app won't change what my doctor does. Even with a nice one-page summary, I'm not sure my doctor will actually read it or change my metformin plan because of it, and I'll probably stop logging before it's useful anyway.
would_change_my_mind: If the free summary actually got my doctor to change something or answer a question she normally brushes off, I'd pay the $7.99 before my next appointment.
